dialogues.speaker: Zarubina
dialogues.text: I'm serious, I think we could actually learn ballet. Rytova's pretty good at teaching, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Tomilina
dialogues.text: You can go if you want. Ballet's not really my thing.

dialogues.speaker: Zarubina
dialogues.text: But I want us to go together! It'd be way better if we were onstage side by side!

dialogues.speaker: Tomilina
dialogues.text: I'd rather watch from the audience, honestly. If you need me up there, I can play a tree. But ballet? Yeah, I'm really not built for that.

dialogues.speaker: Zarubina
dialogues.text: Hmm... Then maybe we can learn to sing instead? Hehe, one way or another, we're getting on that stage together.

dialogues.speaker: Tomilina
dialogues.text: How about this? When you're onstage accepting an award and giving your speech, you can call me up to hold the trophy for you.

dialogues.speaker: Tomilina
dialogues.text: That still counts as being onstage together, right?
